subject: What a Ship Score tells you about your project
script: Busy isn't the same as shipping. You can have twenty tabs open, three plans, and a new idea every day, and still not move. Flayel gives every project a Ship Score, from zero to a hundred, based on what you actually did. When it drops, the project is going cold. When it climbs, you're moving. And Flayel points to the biggest lever you can pull next. One number. No guessing. Try Flayel free at flayel dot com.
